# Revision-bound lesson completion

Student owns completion of a concrete learning path item. Course owns immutable `lesson-revision.v1` definitions. Every newly assigned lesson resolves the supplied exact `lesson_revision_id` through `GET /internal/lesson-revisions/{id}`, or resolves current authored content through `POST /internal/lessons/{lessonID}/revision` when omitted. Student snapshots the definition and learner content on initial allocation, exact-path replan, and onboarding materialization.

Each new assignment has `learning_path_item_id`, `lesson_revision_id`, and `frozen_requirements`. A requirement contains an assignment-specific UUID `requirement_id`, Course `activity_id`, successful fact `type`, `required`, exact `source_reference`, and `satisfied`. Student deterministically allocates UUIDs from the allocation request and occurrence position; repeated references to one revision remain independent. Replans preserve existing item UUIDs and frozen semantics and reject revision changes under the same UUID. New occurrences omit the UUID. Planner request receipts replay before consulting Course or mutable current state.

Course task activity source IDs are task UUIDs and source revision IDs are the immutable lesson revision. Practice activity source IDs and revision IDs are the authored immutable Practice revision. Course policies support `theory_acknowledged`, `quiz_passed`, `task_passed`, and `practice_completed`; all required requirements must be satisfied. Optional activities do not block completion. Failed attempts never satisfy requirements and never fail the lesson. Existing states remain `PLANNED`, `READY`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, and `SKIPPED_MASTERED`.

`GET /api/v1/student/learning-path-items/{itemID}/content` returns only an ownership-checked frozen public content projection. Trusted assessment keys remain in private Student snapshots and are excluded from this projection and all path JSON. Questions, variants, and classification group labels remain available to learners without correctness keys.

`POST /api/v1/student/learning-path-items/{itemID}/theory-acknowledgements` accepts exactly `{ "requirement_id": "UUID" }` and a UUID `Idempotency-Key`. Authentication uses the existing trusted user identity boundary. Student accepts only the item's frozen theory requirement, returns the updated item, and rejects foreign/missing items with 404 and wrong activity/source with 409. No Teacher completion command exists.

New theory acknowledgements, correlated assessment starts/reopens, and embedded Practice reserve/open commands revalidate the Student-owned selected `ACTIVE` path under the existing planning fence. The exact unfinished item must be current: preceding items are `COMPLETED` or `SKIPPED_MASTERED`, and another item in that route cannot be `IN_PROGRESS`. The requested frozen requirement must exist and remain unsatisfied. Requirement presentation priority is not an additional prerequisite; optional current activities remain admissible and do not block completion.

Ownership-checked frozen content/assessment reads remain separate from command admission. A pure read does not activate or satisfy an item. Exact accepted theory-fact, Practice reservation and `OPEN` receipts replay before current eligibility checks. Ordinary task start still has no general idempotency receipt; this change does not introduce one. A valid previously started Course/Practice outcome is not a new start: its existing exact correlation/lifecycle reducer may commit after selection changes or a path pauses. Practice cancellation retains its existing lifecycle guards.

Existing ordinary task-start requests accept the optional paired `learning_path_item_id` and `requirement_id`. Student resolves the exact frozen task, snapshots trusted scoring metadata on the answer, and scopes attempt limits to that requirement. Later submit, retry, and scoring read that frozen snapshot. Only official `PASSED` closure satisfies the corresponding requirement, in the answer/action/outbox transaction. `UNDER_REVIEW` and failed results remain unsatisfied.

Practice reserve/binding/evidence v2 add the same optional UUID pair. A correlated reserve requires an owned selected ACTIVE path and exact frozen Practice revision. Student persists and echoes the immutable pair. Successful evidence satisfies only that requirement in the existing Practice evidence transaction. Legacy standalone Practice item behavior remains compatible. Practice owns its retries and successful runtime facts; it does not own lesson or path state.

Successful facts use `student_lesson_activity_fact` receipts scoped by successful fact type and source aggregate/fact UUID. Student checks exact item, requirement, source ID and revision, and stores the immutable logical request hash. Duplicate delivery creates no additional satisfaction, revision, or journey increment. Source occurrence time is retained; path mutation timestamps use Student processing time so delayed facts cannot regress update timestamps. A fact identity cannot be reused for another assignment. Ordering independent successful facts changes only the receipt order, not final satisfaction/completion.

## Cutover and persistence

Migration 030 gives historical items deterministic UUIDs but leaves lesson revision, private content, and frozen requirements unbound. It does not fabricate a revision or infer completion requirements. Historical assignments retain their previous semantics; only newly assigned lesson occurrences use the new completion contract. The legacy reference uniqueness applies only to unbound items. Migration 031 makes answer/action correlation and successful fact receipts immutable. Existing path revision snapshots are preserved.

The completion reducer does not infer mastery or directly mutate the route.
The formerly separate `MASTERY_REPLANNING` dependency is architecturally closed by
the [accepted Hybrid Replanning decision](https://github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/blob/main/docs/hybrid-mastery-replanning.md): objective completion may initiate
an independent evaluation when new relevant data exists. This does not change
completion requirements, statuses, progress, or the reducer.
`OUT_OF_SCOPE_DEPENDENCY: NEXT_BEST_ACTION` remains outside this contract.

## Verification commands

`.ai/commands.yaml` documents the dedicated PostgreSQL cutover/A–I suite and isolated runtime prepare/quiz/verify phases. The SQL suite seeds historical assignments before migration 030 and verifies nullable cutover, required/optional combinations, failures, duplicates, out-of-order facts, immutable revisions, and repeated lesson executions. Runtime phases use actual Course and Student processes and a separate Practice runtime proof.

The full existing `test/integration` package currently has `UNRELATED_EXISTING_FAILURE` compile references to removed `internalapi.NewRouter` and `FinalValidation.Pool`; this task does not repair those unrelated tests. The dedicated lesson completion suite is compiled and executed as an explicit test file against real isolated PostgreSQL. Ordinary service unit/contract packages remain covered by `go test ./...`.

## Command eligibility regression proof

`COMMAND_ELIGIBILITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL` must name an already-migrated isolated
loopback PostgreSQL database ending `_integration_proof` for:

```sh
go test -tags=integration test/integration/command_eligibility_test.go -count=1 -v
```

The suite checks future/paused/unselected/foreign/satisfied admission, current
quiz/task and Practice starts, optional activity, receipt replay, and late
Course/Practice outcome reducers. Outcomes are constructed trusted fixtures;
the proof executes real Student PostgreSQL adapters, not Runtime/Validator or
live learner E2E. It starts no services, applies no migrations and resets no data.

## Frozen assigned lesson context

`GET /api/v1/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context` reads the authenticated student's exact stored assignment through `GetLearningPathByID`. The equivalent private read is `GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context`, protected by the existing shared `X-Internal-Token` read credential. The composition root wires both to the same `AssignedLessonContext` use case. Trusted actor headers and the STUDENT/STUDENT_PRO role boundary remain the public identity mechanism.

The response is `student-assigned-lesson-context.v1` with exactly `schema`, `student_id`, `learning_path_id`, `learning_path_item_id`, `course_id`, `lesson_id`, `lesson_revision_id`, `content_digest`, and `content` containing exactly `title`, `excerpt`, `description`. All IDs are nonzero canonical UUIDs. Only one exact item is accepted; missing/foreign path or item returns 404, ambiguous items return 409, and invalid/missing frozen identity or content returns 400. Storage failure returns 500 and an unconfigured handler returns 503. Responses use `Cache-Control: no-store`.

Strings are copied exactly from the frozen content, with no trimming or translated/current-content substitution. Each field must be present and a UTF-8 string; title is bounded to 1000 runes, excerpt to 4000 runes, description to 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes, and the final marshaled response to 2 MiB (including JSON escaping). `content_digest` is `sha256:` plus 64 lowercase hex characters from SHA-256 of Go `encoding/json.Marshal([3]string{title, excerpt, description})`. Duplicate content fields and contradictory embedded identity references fail explicitly. Tasks, answers, translations, and provider bodies are excluded by the projection whitelist.

This is a read of the frozen assignment, including historical paused/completed/archived paths. It performs no Course lookup, progression mutation, finalization, or unlock and introduces no command eligibility policy. Publishing a new Course revision cannot change this old assignment's strings or digest. Teacher v2 consumers must verify the complete identity and digest and fail explicitly when this projection is unavailable.
